description: This PHP class 'InAccessibleEntityIdOption' defines configuration and validation rules for entity access restrictions, including permissions, roles, and exception handling, likely used within a validation framework for access control in an HRM system.

classes.name: InAccessibleEntityIdOption
classes.description: A class encapsulating access control validation rules, such as permissions, roles, and exception handling, for entities within the HRM system.

methods.name: getThrowable
methods.description: Returns the throwable exception for access denial; initializes a default ForbiddenException if none is set.

methods.name: setThrowable
methods.description: Sets a custom throwable exception to be used in case of validation failure.

methods.name: getExceptionMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the current exception message used for the ForbiddenException.

methods.name: setExceptionMessage
methods.description: Sets a custom message for the exception to be thrown when access is forbidden.

methods.name: isThrow
methods.description: Checks whether the validator is configured to throw exceptions on failure.

methods.name: setThrow
methods.description: Configures whether the validator should throw exceptions upon validation failure.

methods.name: isThrowIfOnlyEntityExist
methods.description: Checks whether an exception should be thrown if only the entity exists.

methods.name: setThrowIfOnlyEntityExist
methods.description: Configures whether to throw an exception if only the entity exists.

methods.name: getRequiredPermissions
methods.description: Returns the list of permissions required for access validation.

methods.name: setRequiredPermissions
methods.description: Sets the list of permissions required for access validation.

methods.name: getRolesToExclude
methods.description: Returns the list of roles to exclude from access validation.

methods.name: setRolesToExclude
methods.description: Sets the list of roles to be excluded from access validation.

methods.name: getRolesToInclude
methods.description: Returns the list of roles to include for access validation.

methods.name: setRolesToInclude
methods.description: Sets the list of roles to be included in access validation.
